propositions: A live Gerrit dogfood probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion and executes the full four-pass pipeline end-to-end against the rebar repository.

The positive-control patchset with the discovery/evidence refinement directive must produce no project-attributed findings and demonstrate that valid phase-boundary instructions remain in advisory state with routing threshold 0.90 and blocking disabled.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a grounded advisory finding carrying reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], with observable Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 priority/decision attributes.

The final cleaned patchset submitted to main must contain only the valid positive-control discovery/evidence refinement, emit no project-criterion findings, and leave blocking_enabled=false with block_threshold=0.90 unchanged.
A future separately-reviewed data-backed posture ticket is the sole path to enabling blocking; this dogfood observation does not select a lower threshold or promote the criterion to blocking.
